sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/PAMOJA COLLECTION/Pamoja Collection -Malindi Retreat 2026 Rates.pdf
notes: This single PDF is a compiled document actually containing FOUR separate rate cards: Hotel Rudi (KSH & USD), Mwanzo Lodge (KSH), and Malindi Retreat (KSH) - the Hotel Rudi and Mwanzo Lodge portions duplicate what's already captured in hotel-rudi-2026.json and mwanzo-lodge-2026.json respectively; only the Malindi Retreat-specific rates are captured here.
8.5 rooms (as literally stated in the source - likely a half-room/annex configuration, not a typo we're correcting).

Only a KSH 2026 rate card exists for Malindi Retreat; a page for '2024/2025 RATES' in USD is present in the same PDF but is EXPIRED (valid 15.06.2024-31.12.2025) - not used here, noted for awareness only.
No Full Board rate is listed for Malindi Retreat (unlike Hotel Rudi/Mwanzo which have BB/HB/FB) - only Bed & Breakfast and Half Board are priced.

expiredReference_2024_25_USD_notCurrent.confidenceNote: [Expired, not for 2026 use] Valid only 15 Jun 2024 - 31 Dec 2025. Included for awareness that a USD list existed previously, not as usable 2026 pricing.

childPolicy.raw: Same as Hotel Rudi/Mwanzo Lodge: 0-5yrs free; 6-12yrs (or 5-11) 50% sharing; 12+ full adult rate.

policies.payment: Full payment due prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: Cancelled within 5 days of arrival: full amount forfeited
policies.provisionalBookingHold: Released automatically 2 weeks after initial request, subject to demand
